title: Gift-kit readiness
websiteVariant: Independent one-day worked examples generated from the Gift-kit Readiness and Correction 2.0.0 template; upstream releases are unchanged.

observations.meaning: The printed code cannot be decoded on the declared test phone.
The approved source artwork contains the wrong destination.
The intended account can complete the scoped checkout rehearsal.

arrangements.name: Replace inserts and repair the journey

confirmation.meaning: A sourced, positive confirmation for the selected package and all six gift-kit configuration fields, recorded by a named person by the current review time, effective when correction starts and valid through handoff.
confirmation.starter: No confirmation is supplied in the one-day worked-example starter.
confirmation.comparison: The controlled comparison adds one fictional, valid confirmation to both reviews.
confirmation.limit: A confirmation does not grant permission, provide production capacity, establish completed correction or show that a fresh rehearsal passed.

followup.name: Gift-kit review with a longer rehearsal
followup.workflowName: Review gift kits with a longer rehearsal
followup.rule: The author raises the minimum fresh rehearsal from five to ten minutes.
followup.unchangedInput: A five-minute rehearsal no longer supports a complete correction proposal.
followup.restoredInput: With ten minutes supplied, the internal correction costs $300 and reaches handoff at minute 40.
followup.publication: Publishing the supporting app does not replace a workflow dependency; the author must review and apply that exact release to a separate workflow draft.

limits: The worked records, people, quotes, permissions and confirmations are fictional.
Only the declared three faults and five complete correction packages are modeled; the review does not invent an unlisted diagnosis or synthesize partial repairs.
A prospective correction plan is not evidence that the correction, fresh rehearsal or handoff has occurred.
The model uses one recorded person and production resource in a correction, fresh rehearsal, handoff sequence; broader supplier scheduling and real authority remain outside the example.
Configured business scenarios compare independent authored expectations with calculations. Synthetic fixture reviews approve no live case.
